verdicts.note: Company page: "located in Salem, OH" and "have been manufacturing trailers since the Fall of 1999"; NATM and EPA ECHO (332999, operating) give 1664 Salem Pkwy W. Not MAC Salem (1453 Allen Rd). The 22V-824 coupler-weld recall is not used for welding (it does not say whose weld). No OSHA 2025 row; no careers page.

Real in-scope maker on 2022-23 sources: Part 573 22V-777 (263 CR 44050, Powderly; non-CDL gooseneck trailers) and a 2023 NATM article (goosenecks only since 2021, welders, 14 employees, "our plant"); NATM directory lists it today (Gooseneck, Equipment). But hdtrailermfg.com and hdtrailersales.com fail (502 / certificate mismatch), no OSHA 2025 row, no EPA record, no dated posting. Flag: T17 says a current NATM listing alone is not enough; the 2023 article is not current. Not related to vPIC HD Trailer Manufacturing LLC, Elm Mott TX.
